title: ECHA Candidate List of substances of very high concern, and EC inventory identifiers
usedFor: Substance identity for the `svhcSubstances` entries, which carry a CAS number and a SCIP notification identifier.
source: A search for ECHA's legal notice, which returned its German edition. ECHA's own English page answered 403 to an automated fetch on 2026-10-13. Nothing from the Candidate List pages has been read.
finding: The legal notice that surfaced reserves the right to prohibit systematic automated collection of ECHA's databases (scraping, data mining, extraction and reuse) and excludes content protected by third-party rights. No licence statement for the Candidate List itself was found, so `licence` stays null and not "open". CAS Registry Numbers, which `casNumber` carries, are issued by Chemical Abstracts Service and not by ECHA, and their reuse terms have not been looked at.
nextStep: Read ECHA's English legal notice and the Candidate List page for their reuse terms, and note whether ECHA publishes substance IRIs at all. Whatever they say, `casNumber` and `scipNotificationId` stay plain identifiers: naming a CAS number is not the same act as reusing a list.
